integrity: Standalone symbolic and quadrature verifier reproduced the sixth-moment identity, inversion and sharp feasible-region constraints; analytic proof in RESULT.md.
scientific_limitations: Exact Euclidean parallelograms, normalized boundary arclength, and exact population moments only; no statistical stability or arbitrary-quadrilateral extension. Two lower moments were available in prior published work. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Three halving-chord moments reconstruct a parallelogram and have a sharp feasible region
